MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The locking nut assortment fits my recent interest in fastening supplies and could be useful alongside screws and anchors, though I would not need every size.",
    "The nuts were the one natural next choice because they serve a concrete fastening purpose rather than merely being another workshop supply."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs require specific wiring projects and cable sizes that nothing in my recent purchases suggests I need.",
    "Epoxy, cutting wheels, calipers, buffing compound, and magnets each serve tasks I am not currently doing; being useful for repairs does not make them useful for my fastening jobs.",
    "Buying replacement vacuum bags does not mean I need general cleaning supplies, especially a pack of twelve wastebaskets."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of nails, screws, and anchors seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or repair product.",
    "My specific household replacement purchase seems to have been treated as a broader need for household supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener purchases point toward particular fastening needs, where dimensions and compatibility matter more than a broad DIY connection.",
    "I choose supplies when I have a concrete use for them; specialized tools, connectors, and bulk packs need a matching task and quantity."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in fastening supplies but extended it too broadly to unrelated workshop tasks and household needs."
}
